name: Trade-off Sliders
deliverable: Hard ranking of competing technical attributes to eliminate ambiguity

steps.text: List the attributes that genuinely trade against each other, and drop any pair that moves together.
Draw a slider for each attribute with named ends, then mark the current position as the baseline.
For each candidate, move the sliders to show what choosing it requires and which attribute it sacrifices.
Rank candidates by the sacrifices the group can accept, not by a summed score.
Record the final slider settings and the sacrifice accepted for each choice, so the trade-off stays visible.

failure: Every slider drifts to the midpoint, producing a polite ranking that hides each sacrifice and decides nothing.
intervention: Ask which end each candidate must give up. If the group cannot name a sacrifice, that candidate has not been compared.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: Widely used in product trade-off workshops; no single documented originator.
